findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: discover_stocks, get_market_summary · Private data: add_to_watchlist · Public sink: fetch_analysis_result · Destructive: add_to_watchlist, initiate_analysis, remove_from_watchlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: discover_stocks, get_market_summary · Private data: add_to_watchlist · Public sink: fetch_analysis_result · Destructive: add_to_watchlist, initiate_analysis, remove_from_watchlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
